name: Hluk (Czechia)
description: Divided diagonally from the lower hoist to the upper fly by a blue band into a white upper hoist part and a green lower fly part.
history: Granted by decision of the Chairman of the Chamber of Deputies of the Czech Parliament on 18 November 1998 and entered in the Register of Municipal Symbols (REKOS); the flag repeats the colours and charges of the municipal arms.
